graph.name: Syntax Native SAP to AWS Direct Integration Architecture
graph.notes: Shows native integration between the SAP application layer (using an ABAP SDK add-on and SLT) and AWS services without requiring intermediate middleware.

nodes.name: SAP
nodes.notes: Hosts the Syntax ABAP SDK and SLT on the application layer across S/4HANA or ECC environments.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores high-volume extracted SAP data (up to 700k records/min across multiple sources).

nodes.name: KINESIS DATA STREAMS
nodes.notes: Ingests real-time high-throughput data streams directly from SAP.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Handles native publish/subscribe notifications and event messaging triggered from SAP.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Executes data transformations (e.g., converting S3 data into Parquet) and custom logic invoked natively from SAP.

edges.notes: SAP extracts data directly to S3 via SLT and ABAP SDK.
SAP streams real-time data directly into Kinesis Data Streams.
SAP dispatches native event notifications to SNS.
SAP directly calls Lambda functions to perform downstream tasks or transformations.
